dialogue.en: Welcome to Dividia — the city split in two!
The west side is peaceful and green. The east is bustling with activity.
Two bridges connect the halves — north and south.
The Gym is on this side of the river!
Gym Leader Fracta specializes in division — she'll split your team apart!
I designed these bridges to divide the river crossing into equal parts.
Division brings things together as much as it splits them apart!
12 divided by 4 is 3! That's how many Pokemon I have!
Division is just repeated subtraction... or is subtraction repeated division?
I split my time between fishing on this side and that side.
The water Pokemon here are divided between Magikarp and... more Magikarp.
Fracta's strategy: she divides your team's strengths against you.
Bring Pokemon with high Special Defense!
The ratio of my wins to losses is infinity to zero!
Half of my team is cute, the other half is fierce!
In the old days, Dividia was one city.
The river changed course and split it in two.
But the bridges remind us: what's divided can be connected.
I've been training here. The Glitch... it's spreading faster than I thought.
dialogue.he: אימנתי כאן. הגליץ׳... הוא מתפשט מהר יותר ממה שחשבתי.

dialogue.en: The Glitch has me... I can feel it. Please... find the antidote.
dialogue.he: הגליץ׳ תפס אותי... אני מרגיש את זה. בבקשה... מצא את התרופה.
